question: Six years after The Biggest Loser, contestants had regained most of their weight. How did their resting metabolism compare?
options: Back to normal for their size
About 500 kcal a day below expected
Faster than before, from extra muscle
answer: About 500 kcal a day below expected. A team at the US National Institutes of Health followed 14 contestants: they had lost 58 kg on average and regained 41 kg, yet burned about 500 kcal a day less at rest than people of their size and build. The slowdown outlasted the weight loss.
move: The damage from an extreme can outlast the extreme itself.
trap: Assuming metabolism recovers once the weight has come back.
